apps.name: Restring Helper
apps.subtitle: Dedicated Stringing Manager for String Sports Glasgow
apps.versionDescription:
Web Orders Integration:
• Dedicated Web Orders View: A brand new, fully integrated page to track unfulfilled Shopify restring orders.
• Smart Dispatch Tabs: Orders are automatically categorized into "Send Today", "Send Tomorrow", "Pickup", and "All" using a strict 2:00 PM cutoff rule (including weekend logic).
• Auto-Refresh: Automatically pulls fresh data from the server every 10 minutes in the background with a live-ticking status indicator.
• Dashboard UI Parity: Web Orders layout, segmented picker, and order cards match the main Dashboard styling 1-to-1.
• Order Card Enhancements: Tappable phone numbers, product variant details (grip size), customer notes, stencil requirements, and clean order numbers.

Stringer Credit System:
• Team Roster: Configure your stringing team roster directly in Settings.
• Attribution Popup: Prompts a "Who strung this racket?" modal upon completing orders to assign credit.
• Analytics Leaderboard: Live leaderboard tracking rackets strung per team member.
• Secure Reset: Easily reset local history and credit logs in Settings when needed.

Quality of Life & UI Polish:
• Undo Toast: 5-second "Undo" toast after completing orders to revert accidental checkoffs.
• iPad Multitasking: Full support for native Split View and Slide Over on iPadOS.
• App Icon Badges: Dynamic badge showing orders due today and tomorrow.
• Faster Workflow: Removed redundant confirmation alerts for rapid checkoffs.
• Dynamic Empty States: Contextual placeholder messages per tab.

Editing & Workflow Toggles:
• Free Restring Toggle: Locks string selection to "Wilson Sensation - FREE".
• New Racket Toggle: Hides pricing from dashboard and printed labels.
• Unsaved Changes Protection: Prompts a warning before discarding edits.
• Order Context Menu: Restored "Select" option in long-press menu.

Printer & Backend Improvements:
• Printer Tweaks: Guaranteed notes printing on ZPL labels and persistent Zebra connection.
• Backend Sync: Robust null handling for Shopify checkouts, auto-cancellation sync, and customer deduplication.
apps.localizedDescription:
Restring Helper is the dedicated stringing management application designed for String Sports Glasgow. It streamlines in-store and online racket restringing workflows, customer communications, and label printing.

Key Features:
• Order Management: Track drop-offs, tensions, custom string selections, payment status, and pickup schedules.
• Web Orders Integration: Directly track, categorize, and fulfill incoming Shopify restring orders with smart dispatch tabs.
• Zebra Label Printing: Automatically generate and print detailed ZPL job labels directly to Zebra printers.
• Customer SMS Notifications: Automated SMS alerts when rackets are ready for collection, with a 5-second undo safeguard.
• Stringer Attribution & Analytics: Track team workload, attribution, and racket counts with a live stringer leaderboard.
• Multi-Racket Orders: Quickly process multi-racket drop-offs with smart cloning and visual grouping hints.
• iPadOS Multitasking: Optimized for iPad with full Split View and Slide Over support.

New Features:
• Multi-Racket Orders: Process customers dropping off 2+ rackets in one go with the + Add Another Racket button.
• Smart Cloning: Automatically duplicates stringing and tension specifications from the previous racket.
• Visual Grouping Hints: Multi-racket drop-offs display orange grouping notes on the dashboard (e.g., Racket 1 of 3).
• New Bulk Selection: Long press any order and tap Select to bulk delete orders cleanly.

Enhancements & Bug Fixes:
• Instant Dashboard Updates: Edits reflect instantly the moment you hit save without manual refresh.
• Auto-Exit Edit Mode: Dashboard automatically exits selection mode after deleting orders.
• SMS Flexibility: Manual control over notification texts for multi-racket batches.
• Bug Fixes: Resolved infinite loading loop on bulk deletes and fixed theme appearance toggle glitches.

Dashboard & Orders:
• 5-Second SMS Undo: Hold window with an undo toast when marking orders done before SMS is dispatched.
• Payment Methods: Added Card / Cash segmented picker when customer payment is toggled on.
• Pickup Date Hints: Real-time resolved pickup date/time preview during order creation.
• Autocomplete Performance: Debounced server-side prefix search for fast customer lookups.

Shopify & Printing:
• Automatic Shopify Orders: Background order creation on drop-off payment.
• Zebra Printer Indicator: Visual reminder note star indicator printed on labels.
• System & Settings: Real-time SMS credit balance display and theme switching polish.

• Initial release of Restring Helper.
• Track sports racket restring orders, customer details, and tension specifications.
• Integrated Zebra label printing support.
